general_background.title: Preparing a selenium feed in phosphine
general_background.summary: Elemental selenium and trioctylphosphine can form a soluble selenium feed before injection. Preforming that feed separates selenium dissolution from the event that starts nanocrystal nucleation.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Synthesis and characterization of nearly monodisperse CdE (E = sulfur, selenium, tellurium) semiconductor nanocrystallites

general_background.title: Technical-grade TOPO is not always chemically equivalent to purified TOPO
general_background.summary: Phosphorus-containing impurities in technical-grade TOPO can change cadmium precursor coordination and surface binding during colloidal growth. They can therefore change shape selection without a change in the nominal solvent name.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: The Trouble with TOPO; Identification of Adventitious Impurities Beneficial to the Growth of Cadmium Selenide Quantum Dots, Rods, and Wires

general_background.title: Acetate can be exchanged before colloidal growth
general_background.summary: Cadmium acetate can exchange with a long-chain carboxylic acid to make a feed better suited to a nonpolar liquid. That precursor conversion can change when the mixture supplies cadmium to nuclei and existing crystals.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Recent Advances in the Liquid-Phase Syntheses of Inorganic Nanoparticles

general_background.title: An alkylamine changes the ligand environment
general_background.summary: Hexadecylamine can supplement other ligands in hot solution growth by coordinating accessible surface metal sites. A later ligand exchange can change surface passivation even if the underlying crystal remains the same.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
